name: Browser Control
summary: Drive the user's existing Chromium-family browser with deterministic Playwright. Use when asked to inspect, automate, test, or interact with a visible browser tab; continue an authenticated browser workflow; handle 2FA, passkeys, CAPTCHAs, or payment confirmation; record browser behavior; or capture an authenticated network flow.

name: Opentui
summary: Build terminal UIs with OpenTUI. Covers Core, frameworks, components, application APIs, testing, extensions, integrations, deployment, and public API lookup.
